headline: Philippine Inflation Surges Near 4-Year High as S&P Warns of Stagflation Risk
summary: Headline inflation in the Philippines accelerated in October due to surging transport and energy costs. S&P Global Ratings warned the economy faces potential stagflation as Q3 GDP growth projected to slow to 2.7%.
why: The Philippine economy is vulnerable to global energy price shocks, which impact household consumption and central bank policy.

impacts.name: Philippines
impacts.why: Higher energy costs and slowing economic output increase macroeconomic risks for the country.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
